extension.summary: Reports playback and who watched it to CrossWatch.
extension.description: Sends Kodi playback events to CrossWatch, including which household member watched, resolved from smart playlist membership, the active Kodi profile, or a prompt at the end of playback.
extension.news: v1.0.0~beta2 (2026-10-11) - Questions and settings now use CrossWatch-styled windows instead of Kodi's standard dialogs. - Optionally rate what you watched at the end of playback (off by default). Needs a CrossWatch release with rating support. - The Viewers screen shows whether CrossWatch has a route for each viewer. - With a single viewer, playback is now credited to that viewer. - Playlist pickers offer only usable playlists, and clashing viewer names are refused. - Clearer pairing message when you try too often. New documentation site.
